== ''Usage'' ==
Unlike its normal counterpart, along with Sugar and Paper, Assimilated Sugar Cane can also be used to make Sticks.<ref>The Sticks recipe seemingly cannot be accessed because it is identical to the Sugar recipe, and the game defaults it to the latter.</ref>
